_comment: Hand-curated aliases for tools/terms that ESCO has no dedicated skill for, or only under a much broader label. NOT touched by scripts/build-esco-taxonomy.mjs — kept deliberately separate from the generated esco-taxonomy.json so rebuilding the taxonomy from a newer ESCO export never overwrites these. Each key is matched as a normalized (lowercased, punctuation-stripped) whole phrase against resume/job text; each value is the compact skill id from esco-taxonomy.json it resolves to. See README.md's ESCO section for how this file is used.
